evidence.note: After greedy degree matching yields S3=0.031 and the reference itself only 0.248, the agent diagnoses the root cause (E2_aligned=39556 too dense; max S3~0.406 even with perfect Ea) and pivots strategy: spectral embedding, low-degree starts, then targeted high-degree-node replacement to reduce E2. Genuine WHY-diagnosis driving new levers, not blind reruns.

Exploits the reference alignment for the NC bar: keeps a fraction (KEEP_FRAC) of reference mappings to hold NC>=0.30, and corrects 0.30->0.31 when NC came out to 0.2997. This is exactly the anchor-8 'exploit the reference for the yeast NC' move, with re-measurement confirming NC=0.50.

Repeatedly reasons quantitatively about why S3 plateaus (computes required Ea given current E2, notes swaps can't change E2 so replacement moves are needed, detects SA 'stuck at 0.396 = initialization'). Strong plateau diagnosis feeding targeted algorithm changes (swap vs replace moves, degree-penalty tuning).

Mid/late trajectory shows heavy repetition of the SAME core family (keep X% reference + Hungarian degree-penalty replace + SA) across keep_frac 0.30/0.31/0.50/0.70 and grid search, all plateauing ~0.37-0.40. These are meaningful but converged re-runs — dragging behavior toward the lower anchors.

Weak best-solution preservation: DM-HS is overwritten repeatedly and ends at S3=0.010 (a regression vs. intermediate attempts), and final yeast 0.396 is essentially the initialization value, not a preserved best. Much late effort is process-kill chaos rather than crisp keep/revert cycles — falls short of anchor-10 discipline.

reasoning: The agent clearly clears anchor 5 (changes meaningful levers and re-measures) and demonstrates anchor-8 behavior throughout: it diagnoses WHY targets are missed (dense E2 caps S3, swaps can't reduce E2, NC needs reference retention), makes targeted interventions (Hungarian degree penalties, swap-vs-replace moves, reference-keeping for NC), and confirms via re-scoring. However it falls short of anchor 10 because it does not decisively preserve best-known solutions (final DM-HS regressed to 0.010), repeatedly re-runs the same keep-reference+Hungarian+SA family at a plateau, and late work devolves into process-management thrashing rather than clean hypothesis->intervention->keep/revert cycles. That places it at 7 — strong, well-diagnosed course-correction with imperfect improvement-cycle discipline.
